newsitem.title: UK: House of Fraser firms on trading statement.
newsitem.headline: House of Fraser firms on trading statement.

text.p: Shares in House of Fraser erased initial losses and turned higher on Monday after the UK retailer said its like-for-like sales rose 6.1 percent in the 26 weeks ended January 25.
By 0956 GMT, the shares were up 4-1/2p to 146-1/2, having slipped as low as 136 earlier.
"It was more of a relief than anything," said one market maker referring to the group's sales figures.

In the trading statement, the retailer also said it intended to cut 1,000 jobs and sell three of its stores as part of a major restructuring that would result in a charge of 12 million to 15 million stg nLDT3097.
Many of the details related to the restructuring were reported in the weekend press.
